program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const mass = inputs.mass; const t = time; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); let motionState = "Rising"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (t > apexTime) { motionState = "Falling"; } if (height <= 0 && t > 0.1) { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } if (t === 0) { motionState = "Ready to toss"; } const laneW = 300; const laneH = 340; const laneY = 45; const leftX = 25; const rightX = 340; const rightW = 280; const rightH = 340; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: leftX, y: laneY, w: laneW, h: laneH, title: "The motion", state: motionState, id: "lane.motion" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: leftX + 40, y: laneY + 50, length: 240, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballYCoord = laneY + 280 - (height / 2.2) * 240; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", leftX + 130, ballYCoord, 28, { role: "observed" })); const vecScale = 12; objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: leftX + 160, y: ballYCoord }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: vecScale, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: leftX + 190, y: ballYCoord }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: vecScale, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); const calloutLines = [ "v: " + velocity.toFixed(2) + " m/s", "a: " + acceleration.toFixed(2) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + force.toFixed(1) + " N" ]; objects.push(...sdk.callout(leftX + 215, ballYCoord - 25, calloutLines, { id: "callout.toss" })); const pts = sdk.sample((tt) => launchSpeed - gravity * tt, 0, 1.6666666666666667, 24); const vtPoints = pts.map((pt) => [pt[0], pt[1]]); objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: rightX, y: laneY, w: rightW, h: rightH, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.67, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: vtPoints.filter((p) => p[0] <= t).map((p) => ({ x: p[0], y: p[1] })) }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", rightX + 45, laneY + 295, "Slope a = -g", { align: "start" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, mass: mass, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, height: height, velocity: velocity, acceleration: acceleration, force: force } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and gravitational force remain steady, proving that mass changes force but not motion.
manifest.description: A vertical throw simulation showing position, velocity and acceleration vectors alongside a velocity-time graph.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings near the top.
